worldcombat.skill.fierydance.summary: Attack nearby enemies in two beats - the first lights the inner ring, the second sweeps the ring beyond it - with a chance to raise the user's own Sp. Atk.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.use.0: Dance a two-beat fire around the body
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.use.1: Light a whole ring of foes in two unfolding beats
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.use.2: Burn brighter and raise Sp. Atk on a landed dance
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.description: Each beat deals about %1$s special damage, the first covering a %2$s-block inner ring around the user; the foe's Sp. Def, type matchup and crits are settled on hit.
%2$s ticks after the inner beat, the second beat sweeps the ring between the inner circle and the %1$s-block outer edge. Every landed beat shoves its target %3$s blocks away from the user.
If at least one foe is hit across the two beats, %1$s chance to burn brighter and raise the user's own Sp. Atk by %2$s stage(s) (stat stages, up to +6).
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.spiral.on: Spiral dance: a larger outer ring and one more Sp. Atk stage on a hit, but each beat is lighter and windup, recovery and cooldown are all longer.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.spiral.off: Gathered flame: heavier beats, faster and cheaper with a slightly smaller outer ring, but one fewer Sp. Atk stage.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fierydance.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: power per beat %2$s, Sp. Atk +%3$s.
On: a larger outer ring and one more Sp. Atk stage on a hit, but each beat is lighter and windup, recovery and cooldown are longer. Off (gathered): heavier beats, faster and cheaper with a slightly smaller outer ring, but one fewer Sp. Atk stage.
Only dance when the foe is within this range; it is a body-hugging area move, so a larger value still means closing in first.
On: dance when others are clustered around the target so both beats sweep them. Off: rank it like ordinary melee.
On: while Sp. Atk is below +4 stages, rank the dance higher to build the flame up first. Off: never chase the buff on purpose.
